Evaluate the grouped static CLM at exogenous a

Source: R/06-spax_huff.R
dot-clm_group_state.Rd

Per group g the inside choice probability `P_g` has its own kernel and outside weight `v0[g]`; the pooled allocation is the demand-weighted `P_bar = sum_g D_g P_g / D` with `D` the total demand, so the pooled outputs are the ungrouped ones on the total demand: `utilization = sum_g U_g = crossprod(P_bar, D)`, `access = rowSums(P_bar)` and `outside_share` the demand-weighted outside probability (`access + outside_share = 1`). The by-group outputs `utilization_by_group` (facility by group), `access_by_group` and `outside_share_by_group` (origin by group) are returned too; the group probability matrices are not kept.

Usage

.clm_group_state(a, kernels, D_groups, v0)

Arguments

a

Attractiveness, one value per facility.

kernels

A list with the weight matrix (origin by facility) of every group, in the order of the columns of `D_groups`.

D_groups

Demand by origin (rows) and group (columns), nonnegative with a positive total on every row.

v0

Outside-option weight of each group.
